Carbon Auditor Swarm - VCM Verification System

An autonomous auditing system for the Voluntary Carbon Market (VCM).
Uses a multi-agent architecture to verify carbon credit claims against satellite data.

Dependencies:
- amb-core: Agent Message Bus for inter-agent communication
- agent-control-plane: Agent runtime and control
- cmvk: CMVK — Verification Kernel for drift detection
- agent-tool-registry: Tool registration and discovery
